Author: Valentina Vieri
Name: VieriRotationHelper
Description: Single-target, AoE, and dynamic bars using bundled Wrath PvE job evaluators even when consolidation is disabled or Wrath is unloaded. Hilda-style side-by-side icons, actual working hotkeys, positional symbols, cooldowns, and stateful multi-action prediction. Wrath options are copied read-only. This plugin never executes actions.
